Definition: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
BiblicalUsage: 1) to delight in, take pleasure in, desire, be pleased with; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) of men; 1a1a) to take pleasure in, delight in; 1a1b) to delight, desire, be pleased to do; 1a2) of God; 1a2a) to delight in, have pleasure in; 1a2b) to be pleased to do; 2) to move, bend down; 2a) (Qal) to bend down
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
